member.description: Who the credential is about, as the holder labels them.

kind.description: An HCERT certificate; the HCERT carrying a Verifiable Health Link at key 5; or a SMART Health Link.

qr.description: The QR's text: HC1:… for an HCERT or a VHL (hcert-prefix-context), shlink:/… for a SMART Health Link (HL7 SMART Health Links specification).

passcodeToSay.description: True for a health link whose manifest needs a passcode (a VHL, or an SHL with the P flag): the holder says it to the health worker.
